config.onProjectClick.description: What happens when you click a project in the panel.
config.addToWorkspace.description: Add a project's folder to the VS Code workspace when you open it. Off by default to avoid a window reload — adding the first folder to an empty window reloads VS Code (which resets terminals). When off, TermDeck's own Files view and terminals still work, but the native Explorer, Git/SCM panel and global search won't include the folder.
config.onProjectClick.focusOrStartSessio: Focus an existing terminal, or open a new one if none exist
config.onProjectClick.focusOnly: Only focus an existing terminal (don't open a new one)
config.onProjectClick.alwaysNewSession: Always open a new terminal on click
config.autoStartClaude.description: Whether to automatically run the Claude command when opening a terminal. Off by default — opens a clean terminal; when on, runs the command below.
config.claudeCommand.description:
The command used to launch Claude Code; you can change it to e.g. `claude --resume`.

(Security: this setting is machine-scoped and cannot be overridden by a workspace `.vscode/settings.json`, preventing a malicious project from injecting commands.)
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: Only runs the command you specify in user/machine settings (claudeCommand is machine-scoped and cannot be overridden by a workspace).
